objective: Minutas: un solo publicador hacia integrationStore (2 -> 1) + dedup por id.
dod: npx tsc -b && npx vitest run tests/minutosSinglePublisherGuard.test.ts --reporter=dot

invariant.statement: Minutas: los sitios que publican en integrationStore pasan de 2 a 1 (un solo publicador).

metric.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');let n=0;const st=['src'];const RE=/(?:useIntegrationStore\s*[.]\s*getState\s*[(]\s*[)]|integrationStore)\s*[.]\s*addMinute\s*[(]/;while(st.length){const d=st.pop();for(const e of fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){const p=path.join(d,e.name);if(e.isDirectory())st.push(p);else if(/[.](ts|tsx|js|jsx)$/.test(e.name)){for(const l of fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8').split(String.fromCharCode(10))){const t=l.trim();if(t.startsWith('//')||t.startsWith('*')||t.startsWith('/*'))continue;if(RE.test(l))n++;}}}}console.log(n)"
